career_stage.description: Which life/career stage the visitor belongs to.

visitor_context.description: Free-form context the user shared about why they are here.

pain_point.description: Specific communication or career challenge the user mentioned.

socratic_reflection.description: The user's response to the Socratic taste question.

engagement_signal.description: Whether the user engaged genuinely, neutrally, or declined after the Socratic taste.

lead_name.description: First (or full) name collected during lead capture.

lead_email.description: Email address collected during lead capture.

required_complete.description: Set true by the analyzer when all required fields for the current phase are filled.

phase_suggestion.description: Phase the analyzer detected the conversation should move to.
